records.englishResidueReason: Kamping is the standard Filipino loanword for camping and gives the portable stove a natural item name.

records.source: This allows you to cook anywhere, and is not consumed on use.
records.translation: Nagbibigay-daan itong magluto saanman at hindi nauubos kapag ginamit.

records.source: A fast-growing, colorful tuber that makes for a great snack.
records.translation: Makulay at mabilis lumaking lamang-ugat na napakasarap na meryenda.

records.source: Plant in the spring. Takes 3 days to grow.
records.translation: Itanim sa tagsibol. Tumatagal ng 3 araw upang lumaki.

records.source: An uncommon fish found in streams.
records.translation: Hindi karaniwang isdang matatagpuan sa mga batis.

records.source: Valuable, but slow-growing. Despite its pale color, the florets are packed with nutrients.
records.translation: Mahalaga ngunit mabagal lumaki. Sa kabila ng maputlang kulay, hitik sa sustansiya ang maliliit na bulaklak nito.

records.source: Plant these in the spring. Takes 12 days to produce a large cauliflower.
records.translation: Itanim ang mga ito sa tagsibol. Tumatagal ng 12 araw upang magbunga ng malaking koliplor.

records.source: A starchy snack found in caves. It helps miners work longer.
records.translation: Mayaman sa gawgaw na meryendang matatagpuan sa mga yungib. Tinutulungan nitong makapagtrabaho nang mas matagal ang mga minero.

records.source: A rare jelly found in underground lakes.
records.translation: Bihirang halayang matatagpuan sa mga lawa sa ilalim ng lupa.

records.preserveReason: Caviar is the glossary-approved established Filipino loanword for this item.

records.source: The cured roe of a sturgeon fish. Considered to be a luxurious delicacy!
records.translation: Inasinang itlog ng isdang esturhiyon. Itinuturing na marangyang pagkaing espesyal!
records.englishResidueReason: Sturgeon is the conventional common species name used to identify the fish that produces caviar.

records.preserveReason: Celestine is the proper mineral specimen name used by the game's museum collection.

records.source: Some early life forms had bones made from this.
records.translation: Gawa rito ang mga buto ng ilang sinaunang anyo ng buhay.

records.source: A "perfect" catch yields triple the fish. However, each time a fish escapes the "fishing bar", the catch is reduced.
records.translation: Nagbibigay ng tatlong ulit na isda ang "perpektong" huli. Ngunit sa tuwing makatakas ang isda sa "bar ng pangingisda", nababawasan ang huli.

records.englishResidueReason: Chanterelle is the conventional species name for this distinctive edible mushroom.

records.source: A tasty mushroom with a fruity smell and slightly peppery flavor.
records.translation: Masarap na kabuteng may amoy-prutas at bahagyang maanghang na lasa.

records.source: It's popular, and ripens sooner than most other fruits.
records.translation: Sikat ito at mas maagang nahihinog kaysa sa karamihan ng ibang prutas.

records.source: Generates a small explosion. Stand back!
records.translation: Lumilikha ng maliit na pagsabog. Lumayo!

records.source: Takes 28 days to produce a mature Cherry tree. Bears fruit in the spring. Only grows if the 8 surrounding "tiles" are empty.
records.translation: Tumatagal ng 28 araw upang maging ganap na puno ng Seresa. Namumunga sa tagsibol. Lalago lamang kung walang laman ang 8 nakapaligid na "parisukat".

records.source: Ancient people chewed on these to keep their teeth clean.
records.translation: Nginuya ito ng mga sinaunang tao upang mapanatiling malinis ang kanilang mga ngipin.
